fullContentHtml:
RPSC 2nd Grade Teacher Result 2026 – Full Details

Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has released the result for the post of 2nd Grade Teacher (Senior Teacher)/ Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT). This recruitment was released for 6500 posts. Online applying process for RPSC 2nd Grade Teacher Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 19 August 2025 to 17 September 2025. The Examination was conducted on 12-18 July 2026. Candidates who had appeared in this Examination can download their RPSC 2nd Grade Teacher Result 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 17 July 2025
  • Application Start Date : 19 August 2025
  • Last Date : 17 September 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 17 September 2025
  • Exam Date : 12-18 July 2026
  • Exam City Details : 05 July 2026
  • Admit Card : 08 July 2026
  • Answer Key : 28 July 2026
  • Result : 13 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General / Other State : Rs. 600/-
  • OBC / BC : Rs. 400/-
  • SC / ST : Rs. 400/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 500/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is RPSC 2nd Grade Teacher Result 2026?

RPSC 2nd Grade Teacher Result 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
